title: European Product Manager FRP (m/f/d)
description:
Shape the future of structural strengthening. Make an impact across Europe.

S&P is a leading company in the field of building reinforcement, offering innovative system solutions for strengthening and retrofitting existing structures made of reinforced concrete, steel, masonry and wood, as well as asphalt surfaces such as roads and airport taxiways. As part of the globally operating Simpson Strong-Tie Group, S&P combines its expertise in structural reinforcement with the strength and international reach of a leading global organization.

To further develop our FRP (Fiber Reinforced Polymer) product portfolio and strengthen our European team, we are looking for a

European Product Manager FRP (m/f/d)

to join us.

In this role, you will take ownership of the FRP product portfolio across Europe, combining market insight, technical understanding and commercial thinking. You will work closely with colleagues across different countries and functions, turning customer needs and market opportunities into successful product solutions.

It's a role for someone who enjoys taking responsibility, connecting people and ideas, and making things happen.

What you'll be doing

You will be the driving force behind the development and performance of our European FRP product portfolio. From the initial idea to market launch and beyond, you'll keep the bigger picture in mind while making sure the details are right.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Shape the product strategy: Develop the vision, positioning and roadmap for our FRP portfolio, aligned with European market needs, business objectives and future opportunities.

  • Understand the market: Keep a close eye on market developments, customer requirements and competitor activities. Turn your insights into clear product strategies and business opportunities.

  • Connect people and expertise: Work hand in hand with colleagues in Engineering, Marketing, Quality, Sourcing and Production, as well as our European branches and local sales teams.

  • Bring new products to market: Drive and coordinate product launches across Europe, working closely with local teams to ensure successful market introductions.

  • Enable commercial success: Develop product information and training materials, share your knowledge and support our sales teams in positioning and promoting our solutions.

  • Make data work for you: Use market data, customer feedback, sales performance, ROI and product lifecycle insights to make informed decisions and continuously improve our portfolio.

You will also contribute to our annual product line business planning, including market research, product positioning, pricing, sales forecasts and portfolio development.

What you bring to the table

We are looking for someone who combines a commercial mindset with technical curiosity and enjoys working in an international environment.

Ideally, you bring:

  • A degree in Civil Engineering, Product Management or a related field.

  • Professional experience in Product Management and/or with technical products in the construction industry.

  • A good understanding of engineering principles and the motivation to deepen your technical knowledge. Experience with FRP or structural reinforcement solutions is a strong advantage.

  • A strong ability to collaborate, communicate and build relationships across teams and cultures.

  • An independent, structured and solution-oriented approach, combined with a strong sense of ownership and a hands-on mentality.

  • Solid business acumen, including an understanding of key financial figures, as well as good IT skills (e.g. Excel, SAP).

  • Very good written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.

  • A willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.

Above all, you enjoy taking responsibility, thinking ahead and turning ideas into tangible results.

What you can expect from us

At Simpson Strong-Tie, you'll find an international environment where expertise, collaboration and initiative matter.

We offer you:

  • The opportunity to shape and further develop an important product portfolio across Europe.

  • An international working environment with close collaboration across countries and functions.

  • A varied and challenging role with room for your ideas and initiative.

  • Flat hierarchies and open, direct communication.

  • A committed, supportive and future-oriented team.

  • Opportunities to learn, develop and grow professionally.

Ready to make an impact?

If you're excited about shaping products, working across Europe and helping drive innovative solutions for the construction industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln).

Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen

  • Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt

Was Du mitbringst

  • 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen
  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen
  • Pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit starkem 80/20-Schnitt und schneller Entscheidungsfähigkeit auch bei unvollständigen Informationen, getragen von fundierter methodischer Product-Erfahrung

Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.

This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.

You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.

Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.

This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.

Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.

Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:

  • Self-serve clinicians, who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

  • Mid-market and enterprise health systems, managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.

Responsibilities

Feature Launch Positioning & Activation

  • Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

  • Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

  • Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

  • Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

  • Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

  • Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

  • Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

Lifecycle Strategy and Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

  • Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:

    • For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

    • For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

  • Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

  • Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

Experimentation and Analytics

  • Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

  • Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

  • Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

  • Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

  • Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

  • Ensure all programs are developed and executed in compliance with HIPAA and applicable federal and state laws, partnering with Legal and Compliance as needed

Operations and Tooling

  • Take ownership of the full communication stack, starting with Userpilot

  • Evaluate and manage lifecycle marketing technology partnerships, recommending optimizations as we scale

  • Build and maintain process documentation, campaign playbooks, and training materials on internal platforms

  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years in B2B product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or product-led growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of in-app channels

  • Proven ability to craft positioning and messaging for product launches and to ship it yourself, not hand it off

  • Deep expertise across the full post-signup funnel (onboarding, activation, engagement, retention)

  • Strong Product DNA, with sharp attention to user workflows and the details that shape the product experience

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex data into clear hypotheses, actionable insights, and business recommendations

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage stakeholder expectations, influence without authority, and build alignment across diverse teams

  • Track record of building and scaling programs that drove measurable growth in adoption, engagement, and retention

  • Comfortable in a highly regulated, high-stakes industry (healthtech) with demanding clients, where accuracy, security, and compliance are non-negotiable

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Userpilot and HubSpot

  • Familiarity with Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Experience in a regulated industry: healthcare, behavioral health, or health-adjacent

  • Experience with AI-powered personalization, segmentation tools, or ML-informed campaign optimization

  • Experience marketing to a professional or clinical end user

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments.

  • Solid software engineering background, ideally with Java, and an automation-first mindset.

title: Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)
description:
Your mission

At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible.

As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib.

Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products.

 

What you'll do

  • Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality.

  • Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen, ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products.

  • Champion an AI-first approach, exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently.

  • Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices, working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization.

  • Drive technical alignment across engineering teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly across our web and mobile ecosystems.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop your engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Who you are

If you don’t meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

You could be our next teammate if you:

  • You have at least 8+ years of software engineering experience, combined with 2-3 + years of management experience

  • Have experience leading, coaching, and developing engineers, helping them grow while fostering a strong engineering culture.

  • Understand the value of design systems and have experience creating, maintaining, or contributing to component libraries that scale across multiple teams

  • Have a strong understanding of UI engineering principles and experience building consistent, high-quality user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, working closely with designers.

  • Adapt quickly to change, embracing uncertainty and consistently solving problems to achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Are committed to accessibility and understand the importance of building inclusive user experiences that comply with WCAG guidelines

  • Have proven experience developing maintainable and secure products with a focus on code quality, testing, and documentation

  • Your English skills allow you to have high quality daily interactions with the team. German or French are a plus.

     

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience improving developer experience and driving the adoption of shared UI components and tooling across engineering teams.

  • Have worked with cross-platform design systems, understanding the challenges of maintaining consistency across web and native mobile applications.

  • Know how to implement frontend monitoring and observability to improve UI reliability and performance.

  • Have contributed to open source or maintained internal tools/libraries

 

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

 

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

 

The interview process

  • System Design interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • EM Case study Interview

  • Reference Check

  • Offer!

 

Job details

  • Permanent Position

  • Full time

  • Start Date: As soon as possible

  • Remote Policy: Hybrid

 

If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles!

title: Finance Transformation Project Manager
description:
Join Qonto as a Finance Transformation Project Manager, based in Paris, and take full ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives — from analyzing current gaps to selecting providers, implementing new processes, and driving adoption across Finance. Your work will directly shape how Qonto’s Finance functions at scale.

You will work closely with your Finance Transformation peers and Core Finance, Strategic Finance, Product and Tech teams. You will be in the details of our processes and tools, while keeping the big picture in sight.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own your projects end to end: frame the scope, build the plan, governance and risk tracking, and coordinate the delivery.

  • Diagnose our current processes and tools: in relation to your project scope, map the flows end to end, use data to find pain points and compliance risks, and turn them into a prioritized roadmap within your project plan.

  • Choose the right solution: define requirements, run build-or-buy analysis, run RFPs or assess our existing tools when relevant, and recommend the best option, whether that means improving what we have, building in-house or selecting a new solution.

  • Build and roll out hands-on: work shoulder to shoulder with the business teams, Product Owners and system experts on configuration, integrations and testing, then drive adoption across the teams concerned.

  • Steer cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority: run the project rituals, anticipate risks, arbitrate trade-offs and keep leadership updated on progress and blockers.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Project leadership: you have led finance transformation or systems projects end to end (framing, delivery, adoption) for 6+ years, and you drive Finance and Tech teams within your project scope without hierarchy.

  • Hands-on and systems-minded: you map processes yourself, analyze data and test solutions with Tech instead of only writing specs. You are comfortable with finance tools and data flows (ERP, purchase-to-pay or procurement tools such as Coupa).

  • Finance process know-how: you can map finance flows from purchasing to payment and accounting, spot dependencies and design pragmatic, compliant solutions.

  • Structured problem-solving: you diagnose with data, run tool selections or RFPs, and turn recommendations into changes that stick.

  • Clear communication & stakeholder management: you are able to influence across teams and present complex topics simply to any audience.

  • Qonto fit: you connect with our culture and with how we work: autonomy, customer satisfaction at the core, and collaboration across teams. You are fluent in English (French is a plus).

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Cross-functional exposure: work closely with teams across Finance, Product, Tech and Growth, giving you a 360° view of how finance operates in a fintech at scale.

  • A high-impact roadmap: participate in the transformation our current processes, tools and people into a best-in-class Finance function ready for our next stages of development.

  • A playbook to build: help create and refine our finance transformation playbook, challenge existing processes and shape how we work.

  • How we work: a data-driven, hands-on culture, with high autonomy and access to senior leaders when needed.

  • Tools we use: our Finance stack includes SAP ERP Cloud, Coupa, Kyriba, Amelkis, and Anaplan.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Marie Pouzin, Head of Finance Transformation. Marie has led multiple successful finance transformation projects across very different environments (audit, large corporation, small start-up, scale-up). She combines a strategic vision with a hands-on approach, so you get both the guidance and the support you need to make a real impact.

  • Analytical mindset: You enjoy exploring complex questions, researching markets and turning insights into clear, structured recommendations and action plans.

  • Communication & synthesis: You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can structure and present your ideas to a range of stakeholders.

  • Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects, build alignment across teams and break down silos to move priorities forward.

  • Ownership & pragmatism: You’re proactive, detail-oriented and hands-on. You take responsibility for your projects, from planning through execution, and follow through on delivery.

  • Collaboration: You’re a team player who builds constructive relationships and energizes the people you work with.

  • Curiosity & AI: You’re interested in financial services and eager to learn and experiment with AI in your work. Advanced AI expertise is not required.

  • Languages: Fluency in Italian and English is required.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Team & impact: Join the Strategy team and play a key role in shaping Qonto’s strategy and driving strategic projects in Italy.

  • Exposure & collaboration: Work closely with country leadership, senior management and international teams across Growth, Product, Tech, Finance, Operations and Compliance.

  • From strategy to execution: Stay close to the business, with opportunities to move from market analysis and strategic decisions to concrete local initiatives and outcomes.

  • Learning & growth: Benefit from coaching and exposure to different areas of Qonto, with opportunities to grow within the Strategy team and potentially explore roles in other functions over time.

  • AI & ways of working: Experiment with AI on projects and exchange practices with the team during strategy office hours.

Before joining Qonto, she held roles across strategy, marketing, venture and e-business at financial institutions including AXA and BNP Paribas, working with fintechs and startups.

description:

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Where We Operate

Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions, each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more.

The Role

You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do.

You can expect to:

  • Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows.

  • Own the system end to end: infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale.

  • Ensure production-grade quality, performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients.

  • Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations.

Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale.

  • Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times.

  • Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits.

  • Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display).

  • Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time.

What We're Looking For

  • 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance).

  • Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems.

  • Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs).

  • Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture).

  • Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning).

  • Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis.

  • Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase.

Nice to Have

  • Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production.

  • GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding).

  • Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules).

  • NLP background

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation.

  • Real-world impact: your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

  • High ownership: own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

  • A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

title: Change and Transformation Manager - Client Delivery (Fluency in French & English required)
description:
Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english)

Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London)
Level: Programme Manager senior
Team: Client Delivery
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead

Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one.

  • Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams.

  • Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting.

  • Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery.

  • Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads.

  • Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE.

  • Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards.

Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include:

  • Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence.

  • Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business.

  • Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched.

  • Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre.

  • Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams.

  • Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs.

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision.

  • Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors.

  • Fluency in French and English, written and spoken.

  • Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak.

  • Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort.

What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

Compensation: €56 – €75

title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
description:
About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

  • Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

  • An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

  • Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

  • Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

  • Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do

  • Bring global flood models to the local scale

  • Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.

  • Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.

  • Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.

  • Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.

  • Work as one modelling team

  • Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.

  • Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.

  • Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.

  • Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.

  • Stay close to the real world

  • We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.

  • You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.

Who You Are

  • You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.

  • You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.

  • You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.

  • You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.

Technical Requirements

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.

  • Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.

  • Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.

  • Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.

  • Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.

  • Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.

  • MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, atmospheric sciences, machine learning, or equivalent.

Nice to Have

  • Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.

  • Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.

  • Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.

  • Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.

  • Previous early startup experience.

Role Details

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).

  • Start date: immediately

  • Reports to: CTO.

  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity

  • Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.

  • Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.

  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.

  • Working language: English. German is not required.

About Riverkin
We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer | Switzerland | Remote
Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery


Job Description
 
Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.
 
 

What you’ll be doing
  • Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.
  • Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization.
  • Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.
  • Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.
  • Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).
  • Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.
  • Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making.
  • Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

    • What you must have
  • Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.

title: Senior Technical Sales Manager - AI-Driven Software Engineering
description:
About CREATEQ

CREATEQ is a Swiss software engineering company with more than 30 years of experience in delivering custom software solutions and modernizing complex legacy systems. We work with leading international companies across industries such as banking and fintech, insurance, aviation and transportation, telecommunications, and energy.

We design, build, and run high-quality software solutions, combining strong engineering expertise, modern technologies, AI-enabled approaches, and proven delivery practices. Our teams work across Java, .NET, PHP, mobile, and web development, helping clients modernize their technology landscapes, improve their software capabilities, and build solutions that are reliable, scalable, and ready for the future.

We are fully dedicated to long-term partnerships, working as one organization with our customers and taking ownership from the first idea through to reliable execution and smooth operation. With nearshore delivery centers across Europe, we bring together experienced engineering and delivery teams who combine technical excellence, business understanding, and a strong sense of ownership.

People, engineering excellence, and strong client relationships are at the heart of what we do.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Technical Sales Manager to drive new business for CREATEQ with full revenue responsibility. In this role, you will win new clients, shape their entry into AI-driven software engineering, and turn it into long-term engineering engagements delivered by our teams.

Many companies still develop software the traditional way, mostly on Java and .NET. They want to benefit from AI-driven development but lack the know-how, processes, and capacity to do so. This is where you come in: you understand the client's starting point, develop the right approach together with them – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore teams – and close the deal.

You will work closely with management, Business Development, and our engineering leads, and you will be the face of CREATEQ to CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in Switzerland [and the DACH region].

 

What you'll do

  • Build and close your own pipeline with mid-sized and large companies in Switzerland [and the DACH region].

What we're looking for

This is a senior role with clear revenue responsibility. We are looking for someone who has successfully sold IT services before, brings a strong network in the Swiss market, and is equally credible in conversations with developers and with executive management.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of experience selling IT services, software engineering, or nearshore/offshore capacity, including several years with personal revenue responsibility.

  • An entrepreneurial, closing-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently.
  • Native/Fluent German and excellent written and spoken English.
  • Swiss or EU citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Benefits

  • A key role with direct impact on CREATEQ's growth.
  • An offering that is high on clients' agendas: AI-driven software engineering, delivered by experienced engineering teams.
  • A compensation package with a fixed salary and a performance-based component.
  • Direct collaboration with management and short decision paths.
  • Freedom to shape the role, bring your ideas, and make a visible impact.
  • A long-term perspective in an international software engineering company with a strong presence in the European market.

title: Campaign Analyst
description:
Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Als Campaign Analyst in het Customer Retention team speel je hierin een cruciale rol door onze klanten beter vast te houden. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen.

Wat je gaat doen

Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s.

Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance van campagnes. Je analyseert de impact, en je gebruikt inzichten om toekomstige campagnes te verbeteren, zodat we kunnen blijven innoveren in onze retentiestrategie.

  • Je werkt actief mee met het team: je levert niet alleen de inzichten, maar bent ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van campagnes.

  • Je bepaalt en draait de experimentagenda: welke hypotheses testen we over aanbod, doelgroep en kanaal, en wat leren we ervan?

  • Je bouwt, onderhoudt en verbetert zelf de datamodellen (SQL/dbt) en dashboards (Data Studio) waarop het team stuurt.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt een afgeronde WO of HBO-opleiding op zak.

  • Je hebt 2-5 jaar ervaring met marketing (intelligence) en data/business analytics.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en je werkt datagedreven en gestructureerd. Je kunt vloeiend SQL, hebt ervaring met het maken van dashboards en datamodellen en je gebruikt graag AI-tools om je werk efficiënter te maken. Ervaring met dbt is een pré.

  • Je hebt ervaring met A/B-tests, holdout-tests en hypothese gedreven werken.

  • Je hebt commercieel gevoel: je denkt net zo graag mee over het aanbod als over de cijfers erachter.

  • Je bent een sterke sparringpartner: je daagt collega’s uit met data en laat je zelf ook uitdagen.

  • Je bent kritisch, hands-on en niet bang om de status quo uit te dagen.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

  • Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

  • Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

  • Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

  • Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

  • Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

  • Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

  • Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

  • Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

  • Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

  • Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

  • A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

  • Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

  • Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
Specialist Account Executive, Sec Ops
SMB Account Executive (New Business)

Senior Integration Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

title: Werkstudent Medisch Acceptatie
description:
Over ons

Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid.

Bij Insify geloven we dat ondernemers zich geen zorgen moeten maken over verzekeringen. Daarom bouwen we iets wat de verzekeringswereld hard nodig heeft: transparante, eerlijke en volledig digitale verzekeringen, speciaal voor mensen die voor zichzelf werken. Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd.

We verzekeren inmiddels duizenden klanten in heel Europa — en we zijn nog maar net begonnen.


Het Operations Team

Wij zijn het gezicht van Insify. Bij elk telefoontje, elke e-mail en elk gesprek bouwen we vertrouwen op. We zorgen ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord, gesteund en goed geholpen voelen — ook als het ingewikkeld wordt. Snelheid en kwaliteit gaan bij ons hand in hand, en we verbeteren continu op basis van wat we leren. Met een groeiend medisch acceptatieteam en uitbreiding naar meerdere Europese landen, speel jij een directe rol in iets wat echt impact maakt.


Jouw rol

Als Medisch Acceptatie Werkstudent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten in een van de meest persoonlijke momenten van hun ondernemerschap. Je werkt nauw samen met medische specialisten en zorgt ervoor dat aanvragen soepel, nauwkeurig en klantgericht verlopen. Dit is geen standaard bijbaan — je draait mee in een snel groeiend team waar jouw bijdrage echt telt.


Wat ga je doen

  • Samenwerken met specialisten. Je fungeert als schakel tussen de klant en de medisch specialist — je vat informatie samen, signaleert complexe vraagstukken en houdt de communicatie helder.
  • Administratie. Je houdt klantgegevens up-to-date, verwerkt poliswijzigingen en bewaakt deadlines.

title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux

  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
